profile.headline: Software Engineer II - Computer Science
profile.summary: I’ve always loved the idea that computers are essentially powerful, willing helpers waiting for the right instructions. My favorite thing is bridging that gap—finding ways to make technology work smarter rather than harder. I’m a perpetual learner, a fan of elegant solutions, and I’m always searching for that next 'aha!' moment when a system finally clicks into place.

positions.title: Software Engineer II
positions.description:
Building the MCP (Model Context Protocol) layer inside Dentrix Ascend. Allowing customers to chat with AI models and retrieve data faster than ever and allowing customers to build charts analyze data and improve their dental practice productivity.
Built a Next.js/React application that stitches together multiple internal
services, applies MicrosoftEntra RBAC, and exposes only the resources each team needs
positions.insights: Dynatrace, Apigee API Management and +14 skills

positions.title: Software Engineer I
positions.description:
Develop in typescript and make the restful API requests faster than ever. Upgrade the application from outdated code. Update databases from out dated versions. Introduce new security scans to help catch vulnerabilities. Upgrade to latest feature set of Node.Js
Participate in code reviews and discussion on how we as a team can deliver a better, faster, more reliable application to our global customers.

positions.title: Software Engineer Intern
positions.description: Worked on small scale projects to help improve the quality of code that was shipped. Tested new features and played an active role in code reviews

positions.title: Loader
positions.description: Worked with clients to make sure they had an enjoyable experience with Blixt. I worked fast and directed the client I was with to maintain a safe environment for all participants.

positions.title: Sales Professional
positions.description: Successfully contributed as a Sales Representative, proactively reaching out to potential clients to introduce and promote our International shipping deals with DHL. Played a pivotal role in the company's expansion efforts, securing multiple key clients and driving monthly shipment growth by over 150 shipments.

positions.title: Field Technician
positions.description: Engaged in fountain maintenance and repair, actively participating in the construction of bespoke fountains for our clients. Collaborated closely with clients to ensure precise customization of fountain designs. Proficiently programmed city-owned fountains to adhere to day and night operational cycles. Additionally, contributed to plumbing and wiring tasks for the installation of new fountains across various client projects.
positions.insights: Team Leadership, Creative Problem Solving and +5 skills

volunteerExperiences.companyName: The Church of Jesus Christ of Latter-day Saints
volunteerExperiences.description: Helped people in any task that they needed done. Yardwork, housework. Taught people about Jesus Christ and helped them overcome life challenges.

company.name: The Church of Jesus Christ of Latter-day Saints

projects.title: Sorting Vizualizer
projects.description:
Working on implementing different sorting algorithms and visualizing them inside of React JavaScript.
Using CSS to implement the animations of each sorting algorithm.

projects.title: Animal Dictionary Phone App
projects.description:
• Wrote over 1,000 lines of React native JavaScript to test functionality of codebase
• Operated in a diverse team to develop and plan in react native JavaScript
• Implemented a database for storing thousands of lines of data in Google Firebase
• Initiated in team planning for project app work in Microsoft Teams
